ambiguities_or_notes: хлеба то число, которое недостает is rendered as selling enough grain 'to make up what is lacking'; хлеб here refers to estate grain available for sale, not baked bread.
Опекунский совет follows the established project rendering 'Guardianship Council'.
проиграл ... в долг is translated 'lost ... on credit,' preserving that the 575 rubles were a gambling debt rather than cash already lost.
The diary-note sequence and all quoted amounts/dates were checked individually.
